# ForEveryone Berlin — Design System

> Token-driven, digital-first design system for foreveryone.berlin (WordPress +
> Elementor Pro live site, plus a Next.js prototype). Figma is the visual source
> of truth; this repository is the implementation source of truth. The brand
> spec is the ForEveryone Brand Book v1.0 (June 2026).

This file is the entry point for AI agents and engineers adopting the system.
Read the spec files below before generating UI, then follow the principles and
component contracts exactly. Determinism over guesswork: every colour, type
role, and component has one correct answer.

## How to consume this system

1. Import the generated CSS variables: `css/custom-properties.css` (authored CSS
   uses `var(--*)` only — never raw hex or font names).
2. Resolve tokens from `spec/tokens.json` (flattened, machine-readable). Each
   token has `name`, `css` (the custom-property), `value`, `type`, and
   `surface` ("digital" | "print").
3. Build UI from the component contracts in `spec/components/*.md`.
4. Obey the hard rules in `spec/principles.md`.

## Hard rules (never break)

- **Never invent hex values or font names.** Use existing tokens. To extend a
  palette, work in OKLCH: hold the hue and lightness, step the chroma, and the
  new shade already belongs to the system.
- **Never use `surface: "print"` tokens on the web** (Young Serif
  `--font-family-accent`, `--color-print-*`, `--color-doc-*`).
- **Orange (`--color-brand-primary`) is decorative only** — never a text
  background. The only structural exceptions are the QR-code border and the
  white standalone logo icon on orange (no text). Orange icons always carry a
  label.
- **Blue (`--color-brand-secondary`) is for announcements/alerts only**, always
  with pure white text.
- **Body text is Charcoal on light backgrounds**; body line-height is never
  below 1.5; letter-spacing is 0%.

## Files

- Tokens (machine-readable): [spec/tokens.json](spec/tokens.json)
- Principles (deterministic rules): [spec/principles.md](spec/principles.md)
- Component contracts: [spec/components/](spec/components/)
- Generated CSS: [css/custom-properties.css](css/custom-properties.css)
- One-prompt redesign guide: [docs/agents/redesign-from-this-system.md](docs/agents/redesign-from-this-system.md)
- Full docs index: [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md)
- Brand authority matrix: [docs/brand-book-references.md](docs/brand-book-references.md)
- Colour audit + approved pairings: [docs/color-audit-2026.md](docs/color-audit-2026.md)
- Live prototype: the Next.js app in `prototype/` (routes: foundations, components,
  patterns, brand, logo, visual-elements, print, accessibility, governance).
